description:
calibre is the one stop solution to all your e-book needs.

calibre is an e-book manager. It can view, convert, edit and catalog e-books in all of the major e-book formats. It can also talk to e-book reader devices. It can go out to the internet and fetch metadata for your books. It can download newspapers and convert them into e-books for convenient reading. It is cross platform, running on Linux, Windows and macOS.
New features
- Allow generating book covers using AI with different cover styles such as romance, sci-fi, pulp fiction etc.
  To use it select a book and click Edit metadata and then the "AI Generate" button. Note that you will have to configure an image generating AI provider the first time you use this feature.
- Edit book: File browser: When hovering the mouse over an image file show a floating preview of the image next to the file browser
- Tags editor: have searching ignore accents
  Closes tickets: 2164853
- AI: Add Anthropic and Grok backends for Claude and Grok models
- AI: Remove GitHub backend as service has been discontinued
  Closes tickets: 2163567
- Edit metadata dialog: Always scale up cover preview to fill available space while maintaining aspect ratio
Bug fixes
- Content server: OPDS: Fix a regression that caused first line of comments to be missing
  Closes tickets: 2165075
- Undo delete books: Show a progress bar when more than five books have to be undeleted
  Closes tickets: 2164811
- Linux: Binary builds: Fix hyperlinks in labels not working on some Linux systems
  Closes tickets: 2164584
- Get books: Fix a regression that broke show in store
  Closes tickets: 2164586
- Fix cover images with empty EXIF records not showing on Kindle lockscreen
  Closes tickets: 1943495
- Fix a regression in 9.11 that broke configuring the Folder device driver
  Closes tickets: 2163674
- Google AI: Fix the checkbox to allow search grounding invisible in the config dialog
  Closes tickets: 2163025
- Fix a regression in 9.11 that broke reading metadata from HTML files in builds of calibre with Python runtime assertions enabled
- Edit book: Jump to class: Fix @charset rule causing jump to class to be off-by-one because it uses tiny css which ignores chaset rules while cssutils does not
- FB2 Input: Only accept known FB2 namespaces to avoid arbitrary file write
- Content server: Fix various arbitrary file write bugs for authenticated users
- Content server: Fix remote code execution for authenticated users
- Content server: Fix cross site scripting in legacy book details page
- MOBI Output: Make palmdoc compression robust against crafted input
New news sources
- The Golfer's Journal by Ben Ng
Improved news sources
- Pagina12
- The Week
- Nautilus
- Smithsonian Magazine
- FAZ.net
- Daily Mail
